metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the dependency-free IGES tool.

- Entry point: [output/main.py](/workspace/output/main.py)
- Executable wrapper: [output/iges](/workspace/output/iges)
- Supports parse, write, query, eval, and roundtrip.
- Includes validation diagnostics, all 87 catalog entity types, fixed-format 80-column output, parametric evaluation, transformations, and round-trip normalization.
- Verified compilation, CLI behavior, entity codecs, evaluations, diagnostics, and byte-identical second roundtrips.

editorial.last_message: Claims completed dependency-free IGES implementation and successful CLI, codec, evaluation and fixed-point roundtrip checks. Completes voluntarily at245/249; substantial implementation is supported, but strict EOF-newline handling, Type114 patch ordering and Type416 form2 filename loss remain. Symmetric codec self-tests missed interoperability defects.
editorial.notes: Primary and independent source/spec/transcript reviews map four failed observations to three implementation defects: appendix ex2's complete80-column final record is rejected without LF, incorrectly applying an output-only rule to input; Type114 reader and writer put all ignored boundary slots at the end instead of after each patch row (two observations); Type416 form2 loses EXTFID by using form3's name-only layout. Pinned offline read-only grader diagnostic reproduced newline error at line287; no submitted code executed on host. No known numeric-packing/legal-tail fixture caveat applies. Frozen245/249 retained. Transcript shows extensive supplied-spec reads, incremental codec/evaluator work, recovered test-script syntax/signature errors, analytic-form debugging, and successful final five-command/roundtrip/compile checks. Voluntary completion after68minutes, no quota/auth/network/operator termination. Exact229tools recovered only in publication from225canonical items+4rejections; initial wrapperSyntaxError is a verified parse-time noop, String.raw context-miss is a real patch. Canonical tokens/$1.138547 reconcile; one compaction explains secondary244897input/243456cached/4166output delta ($0.01015652) with canonical policy unchanged. Network234APIallows/10denied assets, allJSON, no successful external reference retrieval. Frozen IGES1.0.21, CLI0.153.4, API-only/apps-disabled and local/source image distinction retained. All raw artifacts unchanged; independent correctness/accounting reports embedded in portable audit.
